description: Deletes one saved outgoing webhook for good. Side effect: it stops firing at once and cannot be brought back; nothing else on the site changes. Needs `session_id`, `webhook_id` from wi_list_webhooks and a clear yes (`confirm` true). Read the list first and name the webhook by its name, not only by its number.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that this webhook may be deleted.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

name: wi_delete_webhook
title: Delete an outgoing webhook
